title: imap: LIST glob matching is exponentially recursive
description:
## Problem
mailbox.rs glob_bytes() has two recursive branches: glob_bytes(&pat[1..], s) || glob_bytes(pat, &s[1..]). For a pattern with k wildcards against a string of length n, this is O(2^n) in the worst case. A client with LIST access can DoS the server by sending a LIST with a pathological pattern like %%%%%...%%.

## Acceptance criteria
- Rewrite glob_bytes() using an iterative DP or memoized approach (O(n*m))
- Unit tests with adversarial patterns complete in <1ms
- Existing glob semantics preserved (IMAP § 6.3.8 * and %)
